canonical.behaviour: Release the delivered /spar rework as workflow-axa 2.11.0. The rework is committed on branch spar/architecture-review, main (2.10.0) is merged in, and the version moves to 2.11.0 everywhere it is stated. The docs are updated: a CHANGELOG entry, UPGRADE notes, the README title, a design-history note in docs/DESIGN.md and VALIDATION.md regenerated from a full test run. Then the release and its records are pushed to origin main. Your local checkout D:/workflow-axa and the installed plugin are not changed by this offer; moving them to the release is a second, small offer presented from that checkout.
exclusions: any write in D:/workflow-axa (the main checkout) or to the installed plugin
tags, force pushes and history rewrites
the global rule files and Codex skill copies
conditions: Approving this offer is the owner's OK for tools/verification_summary.py --run --write
The merge of main brings only 2.10.0's release records and version strings; if it conflicts anywhere else, stop and report
The push is a fast-forward of origin/main to this branch: git push origin HEAD:main
checks: git log origin/main shows the release commits after the push
